description: This file is a script that analyzes other source files for improper references to pairing store identifiers within a TypeScript project, specifically for security group authorization logic.

methods.name: getDeclarationNameText
methods.description: Extracts the textual name from different forms of TypeScript declaration nodes.

methods.name: containsPairingStoreSource
methods.description: Recursively checks if a given AST node contains references to pairing store identifiers.

methods.name: getCallName
methods.description: Identifies the name of a call expression node.

methods.name: isSuspiciousNormalizeWithStoreCall
methods.description: Detects calls to 'normalizeAllowFromWithStore' with pairing store entries.

methods.name: findViolations
methods.description: Traverses the AST to find violations related to insecure references to pairing store identifiers in group auth logic.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function that collects violations across project files and reports if any are found.
